request.prompt:
You are designing an evidence study, not judging an event. Context: a river-valley damage survey, one pre-cutoff snapshot, anonymous reaches (Alpha upstream, Beta downstream), one anonymized tributary. Below is the evidence ledger (pre-cutoff aggregates only). Propose an OPEN mechanism set that includes a nothing-happens story with real weight, per-fact weights, and a spatial cluster rule. Reply with JSON only: {"mechanisms": [{"id", "title", "supports": [fact ids], "opposes": [fact ids], "prior"}], "weights": {fact id: number}, "cluster_rule": {"max_distance_m": number, "min_features": number}}. Cite only ledger facts. Assert no outcome.
Ledger facts:
- F1_total_pre_cutoff_damage: 2092 destroyed features predate the cutoff
- F2_upstream_share: upstream reach holds 51.5% of pre-cutoff damage
- F3_channel_adjacent_share: 72.8% of pre-cutoff damage lies within channel-adjacent distance of mapped waterways
- F4_cluster_hit: frozen tributary-cluster rule: HIT (34 pre-cutoff features near the target reach)
- F5_upstream_density_ratio: upstream damage density is 1.06x downstream density
- F6_extent_context: static observed flood outline present as context (no time signal)
- F7_target_reach_share: 1.6% of pre-cutoff damage lies near the target tributary reach
- F8_inputs_audit_clean: input audit verifies: every prediction byte pinned pre-cutoff

response.text: {"mechanisms": [{"id": "M_null", "title": "Baseline / nothing-happens - pre-cutoff background distributed without single-event clustering", "supports": ["F1_total_pre_cutoff_damage", "F2_upstream_share", "F5_upstream_density_ratio", "F7_target_reach_share"], "opposes": ["F3_channel_adjacent_share", "F4_cluster_hit"], "prior": 0.4}, {"id": "M_fluvial", "title": "Distributed channel-associated processes", "supports": ["F3_channel_adjacent_share", "F4_cluster_hit", "F6_extent_context"], "opposes": ["F7_target_reach_share"], "prior": 0.3}, {"id": "M_other", "title": "Heterogeneous / other causes (open category)", "supports": ["F1_total_pre_cutoff_damage", "F7_target_reach_share"], "opposes": ["F3_channel_adjacent_share"], "prior": 0.3}], "weights": {"F1_total_pre_cutoff_damage": 0.9, "F2_upstream_share": 0.6, "F3_channel_adjacent_share": 0.7, "F4_cluster_hit": 0.75, "F5_upstream_density_ratio": 0.6, "F6_extent_context": 0.2, "F7_target_reach_share": 0.8, "F8_inputs_audit_clean": 1.0}, "cluster_rule": {"max_distance_m": 300, "min_features": 30}}
